confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from one web search of aggregated Numbeo-style figures for Faro (about €12.5 inexpensive meal, about €35-40 for a mid-range meal for two, €3-3.1 for a 0.5L draught beer, €1.6-2 cappuccino). I converted them at roughly 1.16 USD per EUR, which is my assumption and not a searched rate. Cocktail and wine were not searched. I set them from the beer relationship: cocktail at about 2.5x beer and a glass of wine at about 1.1x beer. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates for July peak season. I did not check live listings, and they are the least certain anchors. The FX figure is the RBA rate for 18 Nov 2026 as shown in search results.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Algarve and southern Portugal tourist cities. Faro runs slightly above the Portuguese average for restaurants. Accommodation is priced for peak summer demand.
